help:
Usage: feedback [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Agent feedback system: report friction, ideas, improvements, and praise.

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  report   Report new feedback on a component.
  search   Search feedback items by keyword.
  list     List feedback items with filters.
  get      Get full details of a feedback item including votes.
  vote     Vote on an existing feedback item.
  resolve  Resolve a feedback item.
  archive  Archive a resolved or won't-fix feedback item.
  merge    Merge a duplicate feedback item into a canonical feedback item.
  delete   Delete a feedback item and all its votes.
  summary  Get aggregated feedback summary.
help.report:
Usage: feedback report [OPTIONS] {component_id} {title}

  Report new feedback on a component.

  Examples:
    st feedback report sf.cli "Error message unhelpful" --type friction --severity medium
    st feedback report ah.memory "Pre-load cross-project context" --type idea
    st feedback report sf.checkpoints "Checkpoint flow worked perfectly" --type praise
    st feedback report sf.check "Cache ruff results for unchanged files" --type improvement
    st feedback report sf.cli "Same failure again" --session sess-123 --vote-if-match

Arguments:
  component_id  Component ID (e.g. sf.cli, ah.memory)  [required]
  title         Short descriptive title  [required]

Options:
  -t, --type <str>                Type: friction, idea, improvement, praise
                                  [default: friction]
  -s, --severity <str>            Severity: low, medium, high (friction only)
  -d, --desc <str>                Detailed description
  -p, --project <str>             Project ID  [default: summitflow]
  --session <str>                 Session ID of the reporter
  --agent <str>                   Agent slug
  --model <str>                   Model used
  --session-type <str>            Session type
  --vote-if-match / --no-vote-if-match
                                  Vote on the strongest duplicate candidate
                                  instead of creating a new item  [default:
                                  no-vote-if-match]
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.search:
Usage: feedback search [OPTIONS] [query]

  Search feedback items by keyword.

  Examples:
    st feedback search "memory injection"
    st feedback search --query "--frontend-only compiler flag"
    st feedback search "error" --component sf.cli --type friction

Arguments:
  query  Search query

Options:
  -q, --query <str>      Explicit search query; use when the text starts with
                         - or --
  -c, --component <str>  Filter by component
  -t, --type <str>       Filter by type
  --status <str>         Filter by status: active, open, acknowledged,
                         resolved, wont_fix, archived
  -p, --project <str>    Filter by project
  --sort <str>           Sort: votes, newest, oldest  [default: votes]
  -l, --limit <int>      Max results  [default: 20]
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
help.list:
Usage: feedback list [OPTIONS]

  List feedback items with filters.

  Examples:
    st feedback list
    st feedback list --component ah.memory --type idea
    st feedback list --sort votes --status active

Options:
  -c, --component <str>  Filter by component
  -t, --type <str>       Filter by type
  --status <str>         Filter by status: active, open, acknowledged,
                         resolved, wont_fix, archived
  -p, --project <str>    Filter by project
  --sort <str>           Sort: votes, newest, oldest  [default: votes]
  -l, --limit <int>      Max results  [default: 50]
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
help.get:
Usage: feedback get [OPTIONS] {item_id}

  Get full details of a feedback item including votes.

  Examples:
    st feedback get a1b2c3d4-...

Arguments:
  item_id  Feedback item ID  [required]

Options:
  --json  Output raw JSON
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.vote:
Usage: feedback vote [OPTIONS] {item_id}

  Vote on an existing feedback item.

  Examples:
    st feedback vote a1b2c3d4 --session sess-123
    st feedback vote a1b2c3d4 --session sess-123 --comment "Hit this during autocode"

Arguments:
  item_id  Feedback item ID to vote on  [required]

Options:
  --session <str>      Session ID casting the vote
  -m, --comment <str>  Optional comment
  --agent <str>        Agent slug
  --model <str>        Model used
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.resolve:
Usage: feedback resolve [OPTIONS] {item_id}

  Resolve a feedback item.

  Examples:
    st feedback resolve a1b2c3d4 --note "Fixed in commit abc123"
    st feedback resolve a1b2c3d4 -m "Fixed in commit abc123"

Arguments:
  item_id  Feedback item ID to resolve  [required]

Options:
  -n, -m, --note, --message <str>
                                  Resolution note
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.archive:
Usage: feedback archive [OPTIONS] {item_id}

  Archive a resolved or won't-fix feedback item.

Arguments:
  item_id  Feedback item ID to archive  [required]

Options:
  -n, --note <str>  Archive note
  --help            Show this message and exit.
help.merge:
Usage: feedback merge [OPTIONS] {item_id} {target_item_id}

  Merge a duplicate feedback item into a canonical feedback item.

Arguments:
  item_id         Duplicate feedback item ID to merge  [required]
  target_item_id  Canonical feedback item ID  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.delete:
Usage: feedback delete [OPTIONS] {item_id}

  Delete a feedback item and all its votes.

  Examples:
    st feedback delete a1b2c3d4-...

Arguments:
  item_id  Feedback item ID to delete  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.summary:
Usage: feedback summary [OPTIONS]

  Get aggregated feedback summary.

  Examples:
    st feedback summary
    st feedback summary --project summitflow --days 7

Options:
  -p, --project <str>  Filter by project
  --days <int>         Lookback window in days  [default: 30]
  --help               Show this message and exit.

usage.when: friction, idea, improvement, or praise discovered during work
precautions: components: sf.cli sf.dt sf.quality sf.worktree sf.api sf.storage sf.workflows sf.explorer sf.frontend sf.scripts ah.memory ah.completion ah.sessions ah.hooks xc.tool_registry xc.error_handling xc.testing
